invariants.rationale: Returning null is unlikely for write metadata; likely always non-null at method exit.
The write statuses should be initialized and non-null in the returned metadata.
List size cannot be negative; always true and useful for static analysis.
Partition-to-replace-file mapping should be non-null in metadata (by common conventions for such metadata objects).
All WriteStatus objects in the list should be non-null at method exit.
